tool.name: saas_leak_discovery
tool.description:
Discover org-named public pages on known leak-prone SaaS platforms.
Many orgs accidentally publish internal docs to "the world" via permalink: a Trello board left on "Public", a Notion page shared with "Anyone with the link", a Google Doc set to public, a Pastebin upload. These are real treasure sources during external recon, completely invisible to DNS / port-scan / crawl tooling.
Search strategy: - Bing Web Search API only (key-gated on `STRIX_BING_KEY`). We deliberately do not scrape Google or DuckDuckGo — they CAPTCHA non-browser clients aggressively. If `STRIX_BING_KEY` is unset, the tool fail-opens with a clear `error_reason` so the agent can move on. - For each provider, runs `site:<platform> "<org_name>"` and filters results by the platform's known URL shape (Bing's `site:` filter sometimes returns tangential pages).
Findings: - **Info** (CWE-200, info_disclosure) for each hit — an org-named page on a public-by-default platform is a leak candidate, but most are benign. - **High** (CWE-200, info_disclosure, `verification_status=needs_review`) when the snippet contains secret-indicator tokens (`password`, `api_key`, `Bearer`, AWS-style key prefixes, `ghp_*`, `xox[abopr]-`, etc.) — same heuristic as `code_search_for_domain`. The agent must fetch the URL to confirm and trigger rotation if real.
Providers: - `trello` (`trello.com/b/...`) — boards - `notion` (`*.notion.site/...`) — published pages - `google_docs` (`docs.google.com/document|spreadsheets|presentation|forms/d/...`) - `google_drive` (`drive.google.com/file|drive/...`) - `pastebin` (`pastebin.com/...`) - `confluence_cloud` (`*.atlassian.net/wiki/...`) - `airtable` (`airtable.com/(app|shr)...`)
Categories: `info_disclosure`. CWE: `CWE-200`.

parameter.name: org_name
parameter.description: Organization or domain name. The leftmost DNS label is used as the literal-quoted search term. For "example.com" this is "example".

parameter.name: providers
parameter.description: Comma-separated subset of {trello, notion, google_docs, google_drive, pastebin, confluence_cloud, airtable}. Default: "all".

parameter.name: max_results_per_provider
parameter.description: Maximum hits per provider. Default 20, capped at 50 by the API.

returns.description: {success, org_name, providers_queried, per_provider: [{provider, success, raw_count, hits, error?}], hit_count, secret_leak_count}.
